{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - << 'EOF'
src = open('tinydb/journal.py').read()
old = """        # We keep the very object returned by the storage (which may be
        # ``None`` for an empty database) so we can restore the exact state
        # later.
        snapshot = self._db.storage.read()"""
new = """        # We keep a deep copy of the object returned by the storage (which
        # may be ``None`` for an empty database) so we can restore the exact
        # state later. A deep copy is required because storages such as
        # ``MemoryStorage`` return the very dict they hold, which would be
        # mutated by the batch itself.
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(self._db.storage.read())"""
assert old in src
open('tinydb/journal.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
print('patched')
EOF
python -m pytest -o addopts= acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
